A DEC of some vintage at the college where I went to a gifted-kids program on the weekends...I must have been 7 or 8, so this was 1988-89. Early programming in LOGO, and a challenge from our instructor to try and hack his homedir (my friend did, I never managed it).

Years later when I got to college I bought a copy of Mandrake Linux that wouldn't boot on my hardware, and so went Slackware. That led directly to a job running DECs again in college, and retiring their last Digital UNIX (by then it was Tru64) in favor of Red Hat.
